item.title: Landslides destroy national road in remote coal-rich South Cotabato village

item.title: Unfinished repairs
item.description: About three months into the Palarong Pambansa 2026 that will be held in the capital municipality of Prosperidad in Agusan del Sur, long stretches of damaged roads still need repairs. Heavy traffic, including in this portion of the highway in Sibagat, Agusan del Sur photographed on Monday, February 16, is expected when athletes from all over the country will troop towards the venue. MindaNews photo by BOBBY TIMONERA
